title: Brand Tone
description: Structured brand voice and messaging guidelines for copy generation. Each field is a legacy plain value or localized values; localized lists are selected as a whole.

voice.description: High-level voice descriptor, such as comma-separated adjectives ('enthusiastic, warm, competitive'): a legacy plain string or localized values.

attributes.description: Personality traits that characterize the brand voice, used as prompt guidance. Localized lists are selected as a whole.

dos.description: Guidance for copy generation - what TO do: approved messaging approaches, content themes, and reference points. Localized lists are selected as a whole.

donts.description: Guardrails to avoid brand violations - what NOT to do: prohibited topics, competitor references, and phrasings to avoid. Localized lists are selected as a whole.
